items.title: API reports unexpected 9.0 million-barrel US crude inventory build
items.summary: A corrected API estimate shows US crude inventories increased 9.0 million barrels in the week ended November 6, reversing a 5.267 million-barrel decline in the prior week. Distillate inventories also rose 1.5 million barrels. Earlier indexed accounts incorrectly showed a 9.8 million-barrel draw; this corrected industry estimate awaits EIA verification.

items.title: Ukraine drone strikes affect Russian refineries representing about 30% of national capacity
items.summary: Reuters reported that Ukrainian attacks since late October disrupted nine major Russian refineries, with affected installations representing approximately 30% of national nameplate processing capacity. Industry sources estimate an actual crude-processing reduction of up to 200,000 metric tons per day, which is not equivalent to 30% of output. Repairs and actual throughput require further confirmation.

items.title: Rigetti slides after hours following revenue miss despite 108-qubit fidelity milestone
items.summary: Rigetti reported third-quarter revenue of $1.4 million against a market estimate near $3.7 million and a non-GAAP loss of $0.06 per share. An early after-hours account reported shares down approximately 8.7%. The company achieved 99.5% median two-qubit fidelity on its 108-qubit system, but its full-year revenue outlook depends on fourth-quarter customer acceptance.

items.title: Petrobras profit grows but misses expectations and raises 2026 capital spending plan
items.summary: Petrobras reported third-quarter net income of approximately R$39.75 billion, up 21.5% year over year but below the R$47.02 billion LSEG analyst consensus cited by Reuters. Revenue rose 32.4% on strong production and exports. The company authorized about R$15.3 billion in distributions and raised planned 2026 capital expenditures to $24–25.5 billion.

items.title: PepGen surges on Phase 2 myotonic dystrophy clinical signal; FDA partial hold remains
items.summary: PepGen reported 46.5% mean RNA splicing correction in six treated patients in its Phase 2 DM1 10 mg/kg cohort, alongside improvements in several functional measures. Shares more than doubled intraday and ended roughly 90% higher by vendor estimates, which differ on the exact close. Small sample size, durability questions and an unresolved FDA partial hold remain material risks.
